classification_rules.note: Collection errors are classified from full event tracebacks; missing imports of modules present in the snapshot are code failures. Matching external-resource messages are environment failures. Remaining runtime failures are unclassified pending inspection.

first_to_last.qualification: not_run means selected but collection prevented execution; not_selected means absent from a complete filtered collection, not necessarily deleted; unobserved means missing from an interrupted run. These states do not establish pass-to-fail regressions.

lane.description: nova's default fast lane: pytest under the tree's own configuration, whose addopts select --doctest-modules and -m 'not slow'
lane.notes: no sync and no write to the nova checkout; each snapshot runs with its own --basetemp
lane.pythonpath: the extracted tree, then this data directory

snapshot_rule: primary-branch commit nearest 12:00Z on each date, by committer timestamp; before/after candidates and their distances are recorded per snapshot
